summary: Discover the power of machine learning with our IBM SPSS Modeler training course. Learn to build and deploy models effectively.
lede: Machine learning with IBM SPSS Modeler helps data-focused professionals prepare data and build predictive models without programming. The training is for analysts and others who need to turn data into useful decisions. It covers cleaning datasets, building classification and regression models, forecasting trends, and using clustering to identify groups; learners also evaluate model performance, automate workflows, and communicate findings to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This training is designed for professionals who need to extract insights from data without spending years mastering programming. If you’re ready to unlock machine learning’s potential, this course is for you.
modules: Introduction to Machine Learning with IBM SPSS Modeler
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
